text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans, with easy access to team features",
    "Open-source nature provides transparency and community trust",
    "Strong security features with end-to-end encryption and zero-knowledge architecture",
    "Excellent cross-platform availability and browser integration",
    "Reliable synchronization across all devices",
    "Option for self-hosting for ultimate data control"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to some competitors",
    "Learning curve for advanced features or self-hosting setup",
    "Mobile app experience, while functional, can sometimes be less intuitive than desktop",
    "Customer support for free users is primarily community-driven",
    "Some niche integrations or advanced enterprise reporting features may be less robust",
    "Team management features can feel somewhat separated from personal vault management"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Pros item 1: 'Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans' was updated to 'Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans, with easy access to team features' based on the note '[benefit] Creating a free organization took a name, a pre-filled billing email, the Free radio and Submit, and immediately produced a 'Default collection' plus a Members page with an Invite member button.'",
    "Cons item 6: 'Occasional minor performance hiccups or autofill inconsistencies' was replaced with 'Team management features can feel somewhat separated from personal vault management' based on the note '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.'"
  ]
}

pros: Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans, with easy access to team features
Open-source nature provides transparency and community trust
Strong security features with end-to-end encryption and zero-knowledge architecture
Excellent cross-platform availability and browser integration
Option for self-hosting for ultimate data control
cons: User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to some competitors
Learning curve for advanced features or self-hosting setup
Mobile app experience, while functional, can sometimes be less intuitive than desktop
Customer support for free users is primarily community-driven
Some niche integrations or advanced enterprise reporting features may be less robust
Team management features can feel somewhat separated from personal vault management
changed: Pros item 1: 'Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans' was updated to 'Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans, with easy access to team features' based on the note '[benefit] Creating a free organization took a name, a pre-filled billing email, the Free radio and Submit, and immediately produced a 'Default collection' plus a Members page with an Invite member button.'

Cons item 6: 'Occasional minor performance hiccups or autofill inconsistencies' was replaced with 'Team management features can feel somewhat separated from personal vault management' based on the note '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.'
